name: Sun Cleric: Taking Vows already boosts Vow of Light's inherit-heal component by 5 (#1568)
contract: 300331 is ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (aura 107), MiscValue 3 = SPELLMOD_EFFECT1, EffectSpellClassMask word 2 = 0x20000000. Among the several spells sharing the 'Vow of Light' display name, 807750 ('SLS Inherit Aura', the component Vow of Light's own effect 1 triggers via 505197 into the SunClericCopies inherit-amount system) carries that exact bit in its own SpellFamilyFlags word 2 (0x20000000); no other Vow of Light copy does. SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod's generic flag96 AND matches. BasePoints 4 resolves to 5 (DieSides 1), matching 'Your Vow of Light now heals for an additional 5% of damage taken or direct healing done by you' applied on top of 807750's own effect-0 base value (BasePoints 9 resolves to 10) through the ordinary SPELLMOD_EFFECT1 path in Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers. Native only, no server code needed.

steps.label: Your Vow of Light now heals for an additional 5%
